notes: Only public search results and public robots.txt files were consulted. Search snippets served as leads and were not treated as verified product or price evidence.
No offer page was opened because public reuse/access terms were unresolved for candidates, or there was no qualifying official offer source.
Robots.txt content was readable for Rimi Latvia and Rimi Estonia only. For other attempted hosts, the research tool returned an access error; this is recorded as unverified, not as a robots disallow.
The Al Sater search result exposed its public Terms of Service text, including a written-permission requirement for reproducing site content; the page itself was not opened.
No CAPTCHA, login, private API, API key, hidden endpoint, or app-only data access was attempted.
